title: SyncRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for the unified sync method. Send back the cursor from the previous response, or omit it for a full sync. Send owned_service_resources so the server can return the ownership-scoped rows this device is entitled to.

cursor.description: Opaque marker issued by the previous sync response. Server-generated, so client clock skew cannot drop or duplicate changes.

owned_service_resources.description: Resource ids this device owns, grouped by the service and resource they belong to. The server returns rows these ids entitle the device to - a message reaches the device that created it (owned evy:messages id) and the device that owns the record it points at (owned service/resource id matching the message's fk). Omit for a device that owns nothing.

ids.description: Record ids owned in this service resource. The uuid format is load-bearing: these are compared against uuid columns, so a malformed id must be rejected here rather than at the database.
